item.title: Small Entryway Shoe Storage: Choose by Pair Count and Door Clearance
item.description: The best shoe storage for a small entryway is not the unit with the biggest advertised capacity. It is the smallest system that holds the pairs you actually wear at the door without blocking the door. A cabinet can look slim in a listing and still hit the door, and an open rack can fit the wall while the toes of the shoes stick out into the route. Use a count-first, measure-second method.
